canonical_work.title: ELR-1000: A Community-Generated Dataset for Endangered Indic Indigenous Languages

license_scope_reconciliation.conflict_description: The repository root LICENSE file is MIT and GitHub detects the repository license as MIT, while the same repository README explicitly states that the ELR-1000 dataset/work is licensed under KPL BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0 and restricts ordinary reuse to noncommercial terms subject to attribution/share-alike/software conditions.
license_scope_reconciliation.safe_interpretation_for_mlhkp: Do not treat the root MIT software/repository licence as permission to copy, redistribute, adapt, train on, or otherwise reuse ELR-1000 dataset content. Treat dataset content as KPL-governed according to the README unless and until Karya supplies an authoritative scope clarification. The more permissive root MIT file may apply to repository software/documentation, but that scope is not explicitly established here.

deduplication.reason: This record reconciles licence-scope evidence for an already observed ELR-1000 work; it is not a new source identity or new discovery lead.

promotion_state.reason_no_content_promotion: Licence scope is internally ambiguous at repository level and participant/community/cultural-access boundaries remain unresolved for MLHKP content reuse.

release_effect.remaining_exact_gap: Obtain authoritative Karya clarification of MIT-versus-KPL scope/precedence and separately establish participant/privacy/community/cultural-access permission before any ELR-1000 content-level ingestion.
